t: This is Horse and Rider, a bronze equestrian sculpture from 1974 by Elisabeth Frink. It was commissioned for a site in Mayfair, and another cast stands in Winchester. Frink herself described it as an ageless symbol of man and horse. That fits her work well: The Times, in her obituary, said she kept returning to the nature of man, the horseness of horses, and the divine in human form.
